entry.title: Outcome Review System and Structural Refinements
entry.summary: This update introduces the outcome review system — a new Obsidian Base and expanded process for tracking domain-level progress alongside behavior consistency. Several processes were merged for clarity, content was added to domain docs, and the Getting Started guide now clarifies the two implementation approaches.
entry.content:
This update introduces the outcome review system — a new Obsidian Base and expanded process for tracking domain-level progress alongside behavior consistency. Several processes were merged for clarity, content was added to domain docs, and the Getting Started guide now clarifies the two implementation approaches.

Additions​

  • Added israf definition to the Stinginess domain doc: "Israf is spending what you do not have (credit) when you don't need to, spending on haram, or spending for riya."
  • Added to the Sincerity domain doc: "The value of actions is determined by their beginnings (niya/sincerity) and their endings (consistency)."
  • Added to Advice and admonishment (Commanding good and forbidding evil): "When admonishing, be merciful and patient because Allah is like that with you — He forbears despite knowing your faults."
  • Added to Hate the disobedient and love the obedient: "Don't keep company with people who don't inspire you through their state (actions) or guide you through their speech (advice)."
  • Added behavior to Keeping family ties: "call extended family during Eid and holidays."
  • Created regret and prevent.md — a merged process combining Cry and fear misguidance (Fear and hope) and Regret and prevent after committing a sin (Repentance).
  • Created Host guests generously.md under Upholding the right of muslims.
  • Renamed Review working processes → Review processes and outcomes, expanding it to cover both behavior review and outcome review.
  • Created outcome review.base — a new Obsidian Base grouping domains by objective with progress bars.
  • Added outcome property to domain files in the downloadable vault.
  • Updated Obsidian implementation.md to document the outcome property and the two-part review system.
  • Updated Getting started.md to clarify the two approaches: simplified weekly review vs comprehensive Obsidian vault system.
  • Added Weekly review.md and Domain outcomes.md as downloadable vault Resources.

Changes​

  • Merged two envy prevention processes into one.
  • Fixed the focus-to-prayer link in the Praying domain.
  • Merged Cry and fear misguidance (Fear and hope) + Regret and prevent after committing a sin (Repentance) into a single regret and prevent.md process under Repentance, covering the full cycle of fear before sin, repentance after sin, and ongoing balance of fear and hope. Updated domain links across Fear and hope, Repentance, Remembering death, Praying, Gluttony and lust, and referencing files.

Deletions​

  • Removed "have wudu with multiple intentions" process — it was too specific and already embedded in "have multiple intention in worship acts."

entry.title: Enhanced Affliction, Mercy, Reliance, and Asceticism
entry.content:
Additions​

  • Included an analogy of a mother giving bitter medicine to her child to better illustrate how to handle affliction from Allah.
  • Added the definition of fitna in the 'resolving disputes and avoiding boycotting' process.
  • Included the condition of receiving Allah's mercy in the 'hope and fear' domain.
  • Added the hadith about seeing people from hellfire in the 'cry and fear misguidance' process.
  • Included a hadith to motivate being unknown in the 'love of status and ostentation' domain.
  • Added a comparison between the richness and poverty of this life and the next in the 'asceticism' domain.
  • Added another way to get your supplication accepted in the 'reliance' domain.
  • Included the Prophet's hadith about sponsoring the orphan in the 'help orphans or people in need' process to increase motivation.

Changes​

  • Added more details about joking about religion in the "loquaciousness" domain to make it clearer.
  • Enhanced the formula of the progress bar in the performance base view

Deletions​

  • Removed "gratitude journaling" process because it is too similar to the "hamd and thanking Allah" process.
  • Removed "give away unused items" because it was too specific and can be included in other processes.

entry.title: Vision Layer and Reverse Goal Setting
entry.content:
Additions​

  • Introduced the "Vision" layer to the top of the hierarchy to explicitly state the ultimate goal (Janna) that drives all subsequent actions.
  • Adopted a "Reverse Goal Setting" framework to better align the system with spiritual aspirations rather than corporate productivity metrics.

Changes​

  • System Overhaul: Transitioned from the OKR (Objectives, Key Results, Initiatives) framework to a Vision-based structure (Vision, Objectives, Domains).
    • Objectives now refer to the high-level milestones (previously Key Results).
    • Domains now refer to the specific areas of responsibility (previously Initiatives).
  • Updated the "Getting Started" and "Obsidian Implementation" guides to reflect the new terminology and structure.
  • Renamed the Initiatives folder to Objective to match the new hierarchy.
  • Added link in stinginess domain to the spending process

Deletions​

  • Removed OKR-specific terminology (Key Results, Initiatives) to simplify the mental model and reduce corporate jargon.

entry.title: Refining Social and Spiritual Conduct
entry.content:
Additions​

  • Included prohibition of joking about religion.
  • Added mention of death in conversation as a way to remind of mortality.
  • Included examples in the "avoiding false impressions" section under "sincerity and truthfulness."
  • Added the last part of the night as a time for repentance.
  • Added the impact of saying salawat on the Day of Resurrection.
  • Recognized that there can be situations of differing opinions on important topics where no one is directly involved, and added an action to address that.
  • Included the prohibition of fantasizing to prevent lusts.

Changes​

  • Better explained the reason behind "false hope of pardon" in the "Overcoming the Habit of Sin" section.
  • Clarified how to expiate sins in the "regret and prevent after committing a sin" process.
  • Slightly clarified the initiative of "anger."
  • Clarified the benefits of repentance.
  • Emphasized the traveler's philosophy in the asceticism initiative.
  • Highlighted the connection between commanding good verbally and through actions.
  • Restructured the section on gratitude to differentiate between feeling grateful and actually being grateful.
  • Renamed the process "pride and lesser blessings" to "don't be deluded by fame, wealth, lineage, or beauty" to remove ambiguity.
  • Linked the "regret" part of repentance to the fear before the sin to clarify when each state should be practiced.

Deletions​

  • Removed the process "pride and better blessings" and combined it with "don't consider yourself pious or more pious than anyone" because they essentially describe the same action.
  • Removed the process "lower your gaze" and merged it with "guarding your eyes and ears."

entry.title: Nuances of Sincerity and Reliance
entry.content:
Additions​

  • Included a section on hypocrisy in the sincerity initiative.

Changes​

  • Introduced the concept of minimising waste to the gratitude of limbs section.
  • Linked the idea of concealing others' faults to the initiative of commanding good and forbidding evil.
  • Incorporated the action of not worrying into the reliance initiative.

Deletions​

  • Removed the term "self-confidence" from the "advice to women" section in managing the spouse initiative and replaced it with more accurate terminology.

entry.title: Taqwa Model and Waiting Logic
entry.content:
Additions​

  • A new, more straightforward method for applying the system was added.
  • Included the system's limitations and how to overcome them in "Getting Started."
  • Another essential process related to properly using blessings was added: "Guarding Your Eyes and Ears."

Changes​

  • Added more details on how to learn the Quran based on personal experience.
  • Changed the vault links to include a "repeat icon" for recurring processes, enhancing visualization.
  • I added a mention of "waiting" initiatives and processes, which were overlooked in both scripts in the performance section.
  • The last section of "Choose Your Mentors Well" provides additional ways to benefit from predecessors' stories.
  • Revised "How to Manage Desires of the Private Parts" to reflect Ghazali's opinion on this topic better.
  • Renamed the "Reciting the Quran" initiative to "Engaging with the Quran" to eliminate confusion with a similarly titled process.
  • Added links to the Family Support process within the "Upholding the Rights of Muslims" initiative.
  • Included a link to the Seeking the Lawful initiative in the Patience initiative regarding acts of disobedience.
  • Mentioned "Inshallah" in the Reliance initiative.
  • Added more details on balancing fear and hope in the "Cry and Fear Misguidance" process.
  • Included a link to the "Speak Purposefully" process through the "Managing Differences of Opinion" table.
  • Merged "Love" and "Contentment with Divine Decree" into the "Love and Contentment" initiative since contentment is a sign of love, and they are too closely related to remain separate.
  • The weekly review section "Actions Done All the Time" was changed to follow the "Hope-Fear-Love" Taqwa model.
  • Updated specific properties in the downloadable vault to align with the merged initiatives and improve the accuracy of the performance graphs.
  • Highlighted the need to take precautions in the "fear of misguidance" process, as it constitutes the resulting action of fear.

Deletions​

  • Removed the segment regarding excluding supplication in the "reliance" initiative to eliminate confusion.

entry.title: Performance Logic and Process Consolidation
entry.content:
Additions​

  • Added a new process for supplicating during blessed times.
  • Added the Arabic version of the dhikr that we should recite at the end of the gathering to the process "Speak Purposefully or Maintain Silence."

Changes​

  • Merged two processes that discussed praise into one.
  • Added mention of the review tab in the "review initiatives and processes" process.
  • Changed processes tab query to view processes with some initiatives in the waiting stage, hiding them only if all their linked initiatives are waiting.
  • Updated the performance script to include the edge case of implementing all processes.
  • Adjusted the performance section's first query to correctly count the number of processes needed to reach the next level.
  • Added more links from initiatives to existing processes to enhance understanding.
  • Merged "minor sins" and "concealment of sins" processes due to their similar themes.
  • Added more details to the "disregard prohibited and doubtful matters" process.
  • Merged "being consistent with good deeds" with "reviewing initiatives and processes" as the latter acts as the actionable step for the former.
  • Linked the last action of truthfulness in "sincerity and truthfulness" to "avoid baseless assumption," as it involves steering clear of questionable situations.
  • Files with future start dates will appear in the waiting section, even if the waiting property is unchecked.
  • Performance scripts have been updated to exclude waiting processes and initiatives effectively.

Deletions​

  • Removed the "charity in health and youth" process and added it to the "give happily" process as a note.
  • Removed the "situational reactions" process as it was too vague; most of its content is included in the "accepting accusations" process.
  • Removed the "don't misuse blessings" process because it was too vague. There is already an example of its application linked to the gratitude of the limbs, which is "build knowledge in free time."
  • Removed the process for "repenting in the last ten days of Ramadan" since it occurs only once a year; an automatic notification is sufficient. A similar action is tahlil in the first ten days of Dhul Hijjah, which also doesn't require a process that is due for monthly review.

entry.title: Structural Fixes and Refinements
entry.content:
Additions​

  • Added action details to "lower the gaze" process
  • Added performance image example to getting started

Changes​

  • Removed some errors and improved writing
  • Moved "Pride and self admiration and humility" to bad traits folder, which was wrongfully placed elsewhere

Deletions​

  • Removed mention of baseless assumptions in "avoiding harmful speech" process documentation because it already has its own process

entry.title: Initial Release
entry.summary: Welcome to the first release of Roadmap to Janna. I hope it will be as beneficial for you as it has been for me, or even more.
entry.content:
Welcome to the first release of Roadmap to Janna. I hope it will be as beneficial for you as it has been for me, or even more.

I'll aim to release an update at the beginning of each month or less frequently, depending on changes to the system.

Each update will include three sections:

  • Additions
  • Changes
  • Deletions
